# The bulk ingest job's Python dependencies (ingest/README.md), for both the
# Lambda image (ingest/Dockerfile, arm64) and CI (x86_64).
#
# Hash-pinned: install with `pip install --require-hashes -r` (CI and the
# Dockerfile do; pip also switches to hash-checking by itself when any line
# carries a hash). Every dependency is listed, transitive ones included, each
# with the sha256 of every file PyPI has for that version (so one file serves
# both architectures). Dependabot (pip, .github/dependabot.yml) bumps it. To
# regenerate by hand, put the seven direct dependencies (numpy, xarray,
# h5netcdf, h5py, zarr>=3,<4, boto3, and ecmwf-datastores-client, the
# Copernicus CDS client ERA5-Land's live runs import, era5land.py) one per line in a scratch file and run
# uv, holding Dependabot's 7-day cooldown:
#
#   uv pip compile <that file> --generate-hashes --python-version 3.14 \
#     --python-platform linux --exclude-newer <a date a week ago> \
#     --no-header --no-annotate
#
# No netCDF4 and no GDAL: h5netcdf over h5py reads CHC's NetCDF-4 files.
